# Paramount Pharmacy Group (ppgrx)

> > Paramount Pharmacy Group empowers independent pharmacies through technology, group purchasing, specialty networks, and comprehensive operational support.

Based in Piscataway, New Jersey, ppgrx provides a holistic support model for community pharmacies, combining IT solutions, retail optimization, compliance services, and collaborative networks. The organization focuses on sustainable growth for independent pharmacy owners through collective bargaining power and integrated technology platforms.

## Key Topics

- independent pharmacies
- pharmacy technology and IT solutions
- group purchasing organization (GPO)
- specialty pharmacy networks
- retail optimization and workflow
- community pharmacy operations
- pharmacy collaboration and partner networks
- healthcare services and patient care
- pharmacy compliance and transition services
- Cardinal Health partnership
- Dr. Ibrar Nadeem (leadership)
- NAPAP (National Association of Pakistani American Pharmacists)
- pharmacy business consulting
- medication access and specialty care

## Core Services

- [Group Purchasing Solutions](https://ppgrx.com/services/group-purchasing): GPO leveraging collective bargaining for lower pharmacy costs
- [Partner Pharmacy Network](https://ppgrx.com/services/group-partner-network): Specialty pharmacy network offering shared expertise and medication access
- [IT & Technology Solutions](https://ppgrx.com/services/it-and-technology): Integrated IT solutions for workflow, inventory, and pharmacy growth
- [Retail Optimization](https://ppgrx.com/services/retail-optimization): Layout and workflow strategies to improve pharmacy efficiency and care
